description: Kameleon converts outputs from different space-weather models into a common representation and supplies access and interpolation routines. The provider maintains existing code but no longer develops new features or model support. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The provider supplies a public web description. Licence and any software or data charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. Existing code receives maintenance only. NASA states that new functionality and model support have stopped and recommends Kamodo for development. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue.
